name: Lightstream
title: golightstream.com
shortDescription: Lightstream is a cloud-based live streaming software designed for gamers and content creators. It allows users to go live in minutes directly from their browsers, leveraging cloud technology. The platform supports console streaming with features like integrated overlays, alerts, and the ability to have up to 10 guests for multiplayer streams. Ideal for gamers looking to broadcast to platforms like Twitch or YouTube without heavy hardware.
pros: Integrated overlays and alerts enhance streams
cons: Limited to 720p streaming on the free tier
10-hour streaming limit on the free tier
Advanced features locked behind premium tier
